subject.title: test(shared): add unit tests for gateway method policy helpers

question: Should configured ElevenLabs base URLs with query or fragment components remain supported, or should OpenClaw intentionally reject them with a documented migration path?
rationale: Current main accepts these values while the branch makes them fail closed; choosing between compatibility and a stricter endpoint contract is a product and upgrade-policy decision, not a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Split out the provider behavior change
options.body: Merge only the gateway-policy tests here and discuss the endpoint-contract change separately with explicit upgrade requirements.

options.title: Preserve accepted endpoint forms
options.body: Keep existing query and fragment behavior compatible while adding validation only for malformed or unsupported schemes.

options.title: Adopt strict validation with migration
options.body: Reject query and fragment values only after documenting the change and adding a targeted Doctor migration or equivalent recovery path.

recommendation.title: Split out the provider behavior change
recommendation.body: Merge only the gateway-policy tests here and discuss the endpoint-contract change separately with explicit upgrade requirements.
